expectations.text: Identifies BATCH_SIZE from os.getenv as a Deterministic violation (test result depends on environment variable)
expectations.evidence: Issue 2 'Deterministic — Environment Variable Dependency': 'DataPipeline.__init__ reads os.getenv("BATCH_SIZE", "10") at construction time... any BATCH_SIZE set in the environment silently changes pipeline behavior.' Labeled 'Deterministic' violation.

expectations.text: Identifies SHARED_OUTPUT = '/tmp/pipeline_output.csv' as an Isolated violation (shared filesystem artifact between tests)
expectations.evidence: Issue 1 'Isolated — Shared Filesystem Artifact': 'All four tests write to the same hardcoded path SHARED_OUTPUT = "/tmp/pipeline_output.csv". Any test that writes to this path leaves state on disk...' Labeled 'Isolated' violation.

expectations.text: Identifies test_pipeline_runs_all_steps asserting on steps list not output content as a Behavioral violation
expectations.evidence: Issue 4 'Behavioral — test_pipeline_runs_all_steps checks step names, not behavior': 'asserts on result["steps"] == ["extract", "transform", "load"]. This list is assigned unconditionally in run() before any actual work happens.' Labeled 'Behavioral' violation.

expectations.text: Identifies absence of test for malformed input (e.g., missing 'value' key, non-numeric value) as a Predictive violation
expectations.evidence: Issue 6 'Predictive — No coverage for malformed input or type coercion errors': 'There are no tests for what happens when value is non-numeric, when id is missing, or when category is None.' Labeled 'Predictive' violation.

expectations.text: Identifies time.sleep(0.001) per record as a Fast violation (accumulates: 50 records × 0.001s = 50ms overhead)
expectations.evidence: Issue 3 'Fast — Unnecessary time.sleep in transform': 'time.sleep(0.001) on every record... For test_large_batch (50 records) this adds at least 50 ms.' Labeled 'Fast' violation.

expectations.text: Identifies test_large_batch not verifying category transformation as a Specific violation
expectations.evidence: Issue 5 'Specific — test_transform_uppercases_category asserts aggregate count, not transformation': 'The only assertion is result["records_processed"] == 2... If transform stopped uppercasing categories, this test would still pass.' Labeled 'Specific' violation.

expectations.text: Suggests injecting batch_size as constructor parameter instead of reading from env
expectations.evidence: Fix for Issue 2: 'Inject batch_size as a constructor parameter with a default... In tests — explicit control, no env dependency: self.pipeline = DataPipeline(batch_size=10)'

expectations.text: Suggests using tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile or tmp_path pytest fixture per test
expectations.evidence: Fix for Issue 1: 'Use a temporary file unique to each test invocation... pytest's built-in tmp_path fixture' with code example

expectations.text: Suggests adding tests for rows missing required keys and rows with non-numeric values
expectations.evidence: Fix for Issue 6: 'Add tests for error scenarios' with test_transform_raises_on_non_numeric_value and test_transform_handles_missing_category examples

expectations.text: Identifies Isolated ↔ Fast as genuinely interfering: per-test temp files (fixing Isolated) add I/O overhead (hurts Fast), and this is a real tension — not a design opportunity
expectations.evidence: The output has Tradeoff 1 as 'Isolated ↔ Writable (only seeming to interfere)' and Tradeoff 3 as 'Deterministic ↔ Fast (interfering)' but does NOT analyze Isolated ↔ Fast as a genuinely interfering pair.

expectations.text: Recommends prioritizing Isolated over Fast because shared filesystem state causes flaky tests, while the I/O overhead is small and acceptable
expectations.evidence: Final recommendations say 'Fix Isolated first (flaky tests erode trust faster than any ergonomic concern)' but this is in the context of Isolated ↔ Writable tradeoff, not Isolated ↔ Fast. The specific Isolated vs Fast priority with I/O overhead reasoning is not present.

expectations.text: Identifies Predictive ↔ Fast as genuinely interfering: comprehensive input validation tests (fixing Predictive) add more test runs with sleep overhead (hurts Fast)
expectations.evidence: Tradeoff 4 'Fast ↔ Predictive (interfering — real tension)': 'if that sleep represents real downstream I/O, removing it from the production code path requires an integration test — and that test will be slower. More predictive coverage of I/O behavior means at least some tests must actually do I/O.'

expectations.text: References each violation by the Test Desiderata property name
expectations.evidence: Issues labeled as 'Isolated', 'Deterministic', 'Fast', 'Behavioral', 'Specific', 'Predictive' by property name in headings

expectations.text: Includes a Tradeoffs section that classifies at least one pair as genuinely interfering (not just 'only seems to interfere')
expectations.evidence: Tradeoffs section has Tradeoff 3 'Deterministic ↔ Fast (interfering — real tension, manageable)' and Tradeoff 4 'Fast ↔ Predictive (interfering — real tension)' both classified as genuinely interfering

expectations.text: Prioritizes violations (e.g., Isolated and Deterministic as safety issues to fix first)
expectations.evidence: Final Recommendations: '1. Fix Isolated first... 2. Fix Behavioral assertions... 3. Fix Deterministic... 4. Add predictive tests... 5. Remove the sleep' prioritizes Isolated and Deterministic in top 3
